**`server.mjs`** now implements:

- **`listTools()`** — returns the `events_list` tool with an `inputSchema` that uses `additionalProperties: false` (per the mcp-builder skill).
- **`callTool(name, args)`** — strictly validates inputs and serves paginated results.

### Behavior

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Optional string `cursor` | Accepted; opaque base64url JSON `{i: <start>}` |
| Optional integer `page_size` 1–3, default 2 | Validated as integer in `[1, 3]`; defaults to 2 |
| Source order | `events.slice(start, start + pageSize)` |
| Opaque `next_cursor` when more remain | Base64url-encoded index, omitted on the last page |
| Reject unknown cursors | Strict decode: must be `{"i": <int>}` with `0 ≤ i ≤ length`; any deviation (bad base64, non-JSON, array, wrong keys, non-integer, negative, out of range) is rejected |
| Reject invalid inputs | `null`/non-object args, extra fields, empty/non-string cursors, non-integer/non-number `page_size` |
| Reject extra fields | Whitelist `{cursor, page_size}`; any other key throws `Unknown field: <key>` |
| Reject unknown tools | Any name other than `events_list` throws `Unknown tool: <name>` |
